context: No mypy or pyright is configured. Ruff is adopted (D82). Cheap first step: mypy --strict on store/orders.py or codes/qr.py. Not measured: how many errors it would find.

options.gain: A real signal on type errors for little work.

title: Try a Python type checker on one module?
why: Cheapest way to measure the value before committing.
